Import Data & Create Model
```{r}
##--------------------------------------------------
## 0. Setup
##--------------------------------------------------
# Read data
library(readxl)

bc <- read_excel("C:/Users/stewa/OneDrive/Documents/Breast Cancer.xlsx")
head(bc)

set.seed(123)            # for reproducibility

# Model formula you want to study:
form <- diagnosis ~ mean_radius + mean_texture + mean_perimeter +
                    mean_smoothness + mean_compactness + mean_concavity +
                    mean_concave_points + mean_symmetry + mean_fractal_dimension

n <- nrow(bc)
```


Nonparametric Bootstrap
```{r}
library(boot)

# Statistic function for boot()
logit_stat <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]

  fit <- suppressWarnings(
    glm(form, data = d, family = binomial)
  )

  coef(fit)
}

B <- 2000

boot_nonpar <- boot(data = bc, statistic = logit_stat, R = B)

# Add coefficient names
colnames(boot_nonpar$t) <- names(coef(glm(form, data = bc, family = binomial)))

# Calculate 95% percentile confidence intervals
nonpar_ci <- t(
  apply(
    boot_nonpar$t,
    2,
    quantile,
    probs = c(0.025, 0.975)
  )
)

nonpar_ci

```

Parametric Bootstrapping
```{r}
set.seed(123)

fit0 <- glm(form, data = bc, family = binomial)
p_hat <- fitted(fit0)

B <- 2000

coefs_par <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = B,
  ncol = length(coef(fit0))
)

colnames(coefs_par) <- names(coef(fit0))

for (b in 1:B) {

  y_star <- rbinom(
    n = n,
    size = 1,
    prob = p_hat
  )

  bc_star <- bc
  bc_star$diagnosis <- y_star

  fit_star <- suppressWarnings(
    glm(form, data = bc_star, family = binomial)
  )

  coefs_par[b, ] <- coef(fit_star)
}

par_ci <- t(
  apply(
    coefs_par,
    2,
    quantile,
    probs = c(0.025, 0.975)
  )
)

par_ci
```

Residual Bootstrapping
```{r}
# Residual bootstrap
eta_hat <- predict(fit0, type = "link")
res_dev <- residuals(fit0, type = "deviance")

B <- 2000

coefs_resid <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = B,
  ncol = length(coef(fit0))
)

colnames(coefs_resid) <- names(coef(fit0))

set.seed(123)

for (b in 1:B) {

  res_star <- sample(
    res_dev,
    size = n,
    replace = TRUE
  )

  eta_star <- eta_hat + res_star
  p_star <- plogis(eta_star)

  y_star <- rbinom(
    n = n,
    size = 1,
    prob = p_star
  )

  bc_star <- bc
  bc_star$diagnosis <- y_star

  fit_star <- suppressWarnings(
    glm(
      form,
      data = bc_star,
      family = binomial
    )
  )

  coefs_resid[b, ] <- coef(fit_star)
}

# 95% percentile CIs for residual-based bootstrap
resid_ci <- t(
  apply(
    coefs_resid,
    2,
    quantile,
    probs = c(0.025, 0.975)
  )
)

resid_ci
```

NP SE & Bias
```{r}
fit0 <- glm(form, data = bc, family = binomial)
orig_coef <- coef(fit0)
orig_coef

# Standard errors (SD of bootstrap estimates)
se_nonpar <- apply(boot_nonpar$t, 2, sd)
se_nonpar

# Bias = mean(bootstrap estimates) - original coefficient
bias_nonpar <- colMeans(boot_nonpar$t) - orig_coef
bias_nonpar
```

Parametric SE & Bias
```{r}
se_par <- apply(coefs_par, 2, sd)
se_par

bias_par <- colMeans(coefs_par) - orig_coef
bias_par
```

Residual SE & Bias
```{r}
se_resid <- apply(coefs_resid, 2, sd)
se_resid

bias_resid <- colMeans(coefs_resid) - orig_coef
bias_resid
```

Bootstrap Distribution Plots
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

coef_names <- names(orig_coef)

# Convert each bootstrap result to a data frame and tag with method
df_nonpar <- as.data.frame(boot_nonpar$t)
colnames(df_nonpar) <- coef_names
df_nonpar$Method <- "Nonparametric"

df_par <- as.data.frame(coefs_par)
colnames(df_par) <- coef_names
df_par$Method <- "Parametric"

df_resid <- as.data.frame(coefs_resid)
colnames(df_resid) <- coef_names
df_resid$Method <- "Residual"

# Stack them into one long data frame
boot_long <- bind_rows(df_nonpar, df_par, df_resid) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(coef_names),
    names_to = "Coefficient",
    values_to = "Estimate"
  )


boot_long$Coefficient <- factor(
  boot_long$Coefficient,
  levels = coef_names
)

# Density plots of bootstrap coefficients
ggplot(boot_long, aes(x = Estimate, fill = Method)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Coefficient, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap Distributions of Logistic Regression Coefficients",
    x = "Coefficient Estimate",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Bootstrap Method"
  )
```

Wald SE & CI
```{r}
glm_sum <- summary(fit0)$coefficients
se_glm <- glm_sum[, "Std. Error"]

# 95% Wald CI: beta_hat ± 1.96 * SE
wald_ci_low  <- orig_coef - 1.96 * se_glm
wald_ci_high <- orig_coef + 1.96 * se_glm

# Nonparametric percentile CIs
ci_nonpar <- apply(boot_nonpar$t, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

# Parametric percentile CIs
ci_par <- apply(coefs_par, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

# Residual percentile CIs
ci_resid <- apply(coefs_resid, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

bootstrap_comparison <- data.frame(
  Coefficient = coef_names,
  Original = orig_coef,
  SE_glm = se_glm,
  SE_Nonparametric = se_nonpar,
  SE_Parametric = se_par,
  SE_Residual = se_resid,
  Wald_Lower = wald_ci_low,
  Wald_Upper = wald_ci_high,
  Nonpar_Lower = ci_nonpar[1, ],
  Nonpar_Upper = ci_nonpar[2, ],
  Par_Lower = ci_par[1, ],
  Par_Upper = ci_par[2, ],
  Resid_Lower = ci_resid[1, ],
  Resid_Upper = ci_resid[2, ]
)

View(bootstrap_comparison)
```
